creativeDirection: Use daylight location photography to stage a single plausible rooftop scene where one seated portrait and one standing pair are absorbed into a speaker-and-sky setting, while the graphic sleeves become real sky, birds, windows, lights, and painted surfaces.
scene: A city rooftop at golden hour with a tall pole carrying three red loudspeaker horns, a few utilitarian rooftop structures, and a broad open sky streaked with late-day clouds. One weathered red armchair sits near the mast on the tar roof, with a simple freestanding double-window frame nearby opening onto the sky like a salvaged architectural fragment.

elements.element: the man seated front-facing in a worn red armchair, kept recognisable with his hat and slouched pose
a large pale white moon low in the blue sky and a flock of black birds arcing upward to the right
the two young people standing side by side on the rooftop, kept recognisable in their styling and stance, with rust and amber tones folded into the clouds and roof details
a short strand of glowing white star-shaped bulbs hanging from a rooftop cable near the mast
warm spotlight-like glare catching a metal chair and reflective fabric draped over it near the seated man
the three red loudspeaker horns on a white pole as the main structural object
a pink-painted double-window frame standing open on the roof, with a bulky green coat hung from it like a figure-shaped garment and a small crescent moon in the sky

coverSummaries.album: Let Me Come Over 25th Anniversary Edition
coverSummaries.description: A warm, grainy photograph of one man sitting slouched in a worn red armchair in a sparse room with pale wooden plank walls. He wears a hat, jacket, dark trousers, and dark shoes. A small framed picture hangs high on the left wall and another hat hangs on the right wall. The floor is bare and a patterned rug edge appears at the bottom right. The composition is centered on the seated figure with strong orange-yellow tinting.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: man seated in a red armchair
coverSummaries.people: one man seated front-facing in an armchair

coverSummaries.description: A minimalist blue-toned illustrated cover showing a black silhouette of a seated person on a tiny island or rock in the lower center, backed by a large glowing white circular moon or sun. A flock of black birds arcs upward diagonally from the figure toward the upper right. The rest of the image is an open blue sky or sea gradient with faint distressed texture.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: flock of birds rising from a seated silhouette before a large white moon

coverSummaries.description: A stylized autumn landscape photograph with two young people standing side by side on a leaf-strewn path. One has very long light hair and wears a short dark outfit with high-top shoes; the other has dark curly hair and wears loose dark overalls. Around them are reddish shrubs, grasses, a small structure at left, distant hills, and dramatic heavy clouds filling the sky. The scene is dominated by warm brown, rust, and amber tones.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: two young people standing in an autumn landscape under dramatic clouds
coverSummaries.people: two young people standing side by side outdoors

coverSummaries.description: A high-contrast close-up photograph of one person reaching both hands toward the camera, making the hands appear oversized in the foreground. Bright white star-shaped lights hang on strings around the figure against a deep blue and black background. The person’s face is mostly obscured by the hands and shadow, with tousled dark hair visible. The composition is dynamic and centered on the outstretched hands and glowing stars.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: outstretched hands surrounded by hanging glowing stars
coverSummaries.people: one person reaching both hands toward the camera

coverSummaries.description: A painted nocturnal jungle scene framed within a border, showing dense tropical foliage around a reflective pond. Visible animals include a white wading bird in the water, elephants in the middle distance, and a crocodile or alligator near the water’s edge. The sky glows pale yellow-green near the horizon and deepens to darker tones above, with small star-like sparkles scattered through the scene.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: lush tropical pond scene with a white wading bird and dense foliage

coverSummaries.description: A dark blue-toned cover with a wide horizontal photographic strip across the middle. In the strip, one woman sits or reclines in a chair under several bright stage-like spotlights, wearing a shiny light-colored dress. The surrounding areas are solid dark blue, and the central image is grainy and dim with strong light glare.
coverSummaries.people: one woman seated under stage lights

coverSummaries.description: A mostly beige cover with a rectangular landscape photograph inset near the bottom center. The inset shows three large red loudspeaker horns mounted on a white pole against a dusk sky with blue, purple, and pink clouds above a dark horizon. The overall layout is sparse with a textured cream background around the inset image.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: three red loudspeaker horns on a pole against a sunset sky

coverSummaries.description: A simple cartoon-style illustration on a white background showing a bulky green-suited figure from behind, standing between two open pink-framed windows. Beyond the windows is a flat blue night sky with a small yellow crescent moon and tiny black dots suggesting stars. The figure has small yellow shoes and a tiny head peeking above the oversized body.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: cartoon figure seen from behind between two open windows

prompt: A golden-hour rooftop photograph seen from a low angle, with open sky taking most of the frame and a tall white pole carrying three red loudspeaker horns rising at one side; near it, the man from reference image 1 sits front-facing and slouched in his worn red armchair on the tar roof, fully recognisable in his hat, jacket, dark trousers, and dark shoes. The two young people from reference image 3 stand side by side a short distance away on the same roof, fully recognisable in their pose, hair, and clothing, as if calmly sharing the moment rather than performing. Include a salvaged pink double-window frame standing open on the rooftop with blue sky beyond it, a bulky green coat or padded garment hung on it to echo a back-turned figure, a large pale white moon low in the sky, a crescent moon faintly higher off to one side, a flock of black birds arcing upward across the blue, and a short string of glowing white star-shaped bulbs hanging from a cable near the speaker mast. Add subtle rooftop details only: a small framed picture leaned against a vent, a second hat hanging from a pipe, the edge of a patterned rug, and a spare metal chair with a shiny pale fabric draped over it catching bright glare like stage lights. Shoot as crisp realistic location photography, physically plausible, no collage, no poster-like album recreations. Compose asymmetrically with the seated man low in frame, the standing pair offset, and the speaker mast cutting into the sky; keep faces sharp and clear. Light with clean golden-hour sun and luminous late-day clouds, bright and well exposed. Palette of sky blue, cream, red, rust, amber, pink, green, and white; mood open, strange, and expectant. Reference map for people (the album images are attached in this numbered order): reference image 1 shows one man seated front-facing in an armchair, and reference image 9 is an enlarged close-up of those same people - take their faces from reference image 9; reference image 3 shows two young people standing side by side outdoors, and reference image 10 is an enlarged close-up of those same people - take their faces from reference image 10. Copy each of these faces directly from that numbered reference image - same face, bone structure, hair, expression, and styling - rather than drawing a new person from the description. Nobody from reference images 4, 6 appears in the picture: use those images only for colour, setting, and objects, and add no figures, faces, or silhouettes from them. Hard constraints (override any conflicting source material): Create a single cohesive 16:9 image, not a grid, contact sheet, row of covers, or collage of separate panels. Do not reproduce the album sleeves as framed thumbnails, and do not get round that by copying a sleeve flat onto a mural, banner, poster, billboard, tapestry, wall panel, screen, or floor graphic; transform their non-text visual motifs into one original composition. Include no readable text or lettering of any kind: no words, letters, numbers, code, glyphs, captions, titles, logos, watermarks, labels, or signage. Feature only adults and avoid gore, wounds, body horror, medical or anatomical imagery, blank or milky eyes, nudity, sexual content, weapons, and hate symbols; reinterpret any sensitive source motif abstractly. When a source includes a person, closely match their visible appearance and likeness to the reference image, preserving recognisable facial features, hair, skin tone, clothing, and styling, and their apparent age: every person is shown as the adult they are on the sleeve, never younger, smoothed, or more boyish or girlish. Keep each reference person in the pose, expression, and gaze the sleeve shows, and keep every identifiable face sharp, lit, unobscured, and in focus: no motion blur, long-exposure smearing, steam, fog, shadow, crowding, or shallow depth of field over a reference person's face. Expose the image brightly and cleanly: open, readable shadows and clear colour, with no murky underexposure, crushed blacks, heavy film grain, digital noise, or dust-and-scratches texture. Add no incidental plants: no flowers, potted plants, planters, climbing vines, ivy, hanging foliage, hedges, lawns, flower beds, or greenery framing the edges or carpeting the floor, unless the description above explicitly asks for that plant as part of a source motif or the year treatment. Dress the scene with the materials of the place itself - stone, metal, concrete, wood, fabric, glass, water, equipment - rather than vegetation. Everyone in the picture is photographed in the same place, at the same moment, under the same light as the rest of the scene, in full colour and with the same lens and grain: do not carry over a sleeve's own backdrop, studio lighting, backlit flare, monochrome, colour cast, or print texture onto the person. Depict each identifiable reference person only once in the entire composition; do not repeat or clone them as another figure, reflection, mirror portrait, poster, billboard, screen, photograph, painting, silhouette, or background face. The only exception is repetition visibly intrinsic to one source cover: keep that repetition within that single source motif and do not echo the person elsewhere.
